description: Measure bounded-depth manifest discovery independently of the broad upstream matrix.
preconditions: The controlled upstream fixture has been configured and one healthy image has completed.
assertions: The 66-manifest chain reaches the default depth limit within the existing five-minute bound.
Storage and worker observations are retained before and after the traversal, including failures.

checks.description: Verify depth-limit outcome and deadline with phase evidence.

outputs: Depth-limit task evidence, phase timings, worker status, and storage metrics.
